<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Poker Wrapper</title>
<style>
  :root { color-scheme: dark; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: #101418; color: #e8edf2; font: 16px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 14px 40px; }
  h1 { font-size: 20px; margin: 0; }
  .sub { color: #8fa1b3; font-size: 12.5px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 20px; padding: 2px 10px; margin: 0 6px 6px 0; background: #26303a; color: #8fa1b3; }
  .badge.ok { background: #123524; color: #5ee39a; }
  .badge.bad { background: #3a1a1a; color: #ff8a80; }
  .badge.warn { background: #3a2f16; color: #ffce56; }
  /* THE CHAIN LINE (2026-09-25): a banner only when the answer did NOT come the happy way (its ranges were rebuilt,
     it cost extra requests, or there is no answer), and always the session's clean count, small */
  #sa-chain { display: none; margin: 6px 0 0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; }
  #sa-chain.warn { display: block; background: #3a2f16; color: #ffce56; border: 1px solid #5c4a1f; }
  #sa-chain.bad { display: block; background: #3a1a1a; color: #ff8a80; border: 1px solid #5c2626; }
  #sa-chain b { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; }
  #sa-chainrate { color: #8fa1b3; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 4px; }
  /* RANGES AT THIS NODE (2026-09-30): the dashboard's own grid renderer draws here (the study API's /study/grid169.js +
     .css, loaded on first use); these are the theme names it reads, in the panel's colours */
  :root { --surface: #151b22; --surface2: #1c242c; --surface3: #26303a; --line: #2c3a4a; --grid: #1c242c; --ink: #e8edf2;
          --muted: #8fa1b3; --faint: #6b7d8f; --ev: #ffce56; --chip: #26303a; --shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
          --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }
  #rg-card h2 .sub { font-weight: 400; font-size: 12.5px; margin: 0 0 0 8px; }
  #rg-card .rg-wrap { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
  #rg-card .rg-one { min-width: 0; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #rg-card .rg-h { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 10px; color: #b9c6d6; }
  #rg-card .rg-h b { font-size: 15px; color: #e8edf2; }
  #rg-card .rg-h.you b { color: #ffce56; }
  #rg-card .rg-mix { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13.5px; } #rg-card .rg-mix b { color: #e8edf2; }
  .spin { display: inline-block; animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite; }
  /* ALL FOUR TABLES ON ONE TAB: the leader collects every table's answer (GET
     /tables) so you watch the session from one panel instead of four windows.
     A table whose turn it is gets the accent; one that cannot be pressed on
     cannot be reached says so rather than looking merely untidy. */
  .tgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin: 4px 0 2px; }
  .tcard { border: 1px solid #2c3a4a; border-left: 3px solid #2c3a4a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #151b22; min-width: 0; }
  .tcard.turn { border-left-color: #5ee39a; background: #16211b; }
  .tcard.dead { border-left-color: #ff6b6b; opacity: .75; }
  .tcard.narrow { border-left-color: #ffce56; }
  .tcard .th { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #8fa1b3; }
  .tcard .th b { color: #e8edf2; font-size: 13px; }
  .tcard .th a { color: #8fa1b3; text-decoration: none; margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; }
  .tcard .th a:hover { color: #8ab4f8; }
  .tcard .ta { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.25; word-break: break-word; }
  .tcard .ta.none { color: #6b7d8f; font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; }
  .tcard .ts { font-size: 11.5px; color: #6b7d8f; margin-top: 3px; }
  .tcard .warn { color: #ffce56; }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  /* header: title, the two modes, the connection pill */
  .top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .modes { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #2c3a4a; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
  .modes button { background: #171d24; color: #8fa1b3; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
  .modes button.on { background: #1f6feb; color: #fff; }
  .modes button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4da3ff; outline-offset: -2px; }
  #conn-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-radius: 20px; padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #3a4453; background: #1a212c; color: #b9c6d6; cursor: pointer; margin-left: auto; }
  #conn-pill .dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4a5561; }
  #conn-pill.ok { background: #14281e; color: #5ee39a; border-color: #2f6b4a; } #conn-pill.ok .dot { background: #5ee39a; }
  #conn-pill.bad { background: #57222a; color: #ff9a9a; border-color: #ff7373; animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } #conn-pill.bad .dot { background: #ff8a80; }
  #conn-pill.busy { background: #3a2f16; color: #ffce56; border-color: #8a6a22; } #conn-pill.busy .dot { background: #ffce56; }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: none; } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,115,115,.22); } }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { #conn-pill.bad { animation: none; } .spin { animation: none; } }
  /* GTO Wizard meter (2026-09-27): each registered account's light and its trailing hour against the 2,250 limit,
     plus all of them combined, from /session/gtow-accounts every 10 s. Click = the account list under Connection. */
  #gtow-meter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12px; color: #8fa1b3; }
  #gtow-meter .gm { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; border: 1px solid #2c3a4a; border-radius: 20px; padding: 3px 9px; background: #171d24; cursor: pointer; }
  #gtow-meter .gm .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4a5561; flex: none; }
  #gtow-meter .gm.up .dot { background: #5ee39a; } #gtow-meter .gm.walled .dot, #gtow-meter .gm.down .dot { background: #ff8a80; }
  #gtow-meter .gm.no-token .dot, #gtow-meter .gm.signed-out .dot { background: #ffcf70; } #gtow-meter .gm.off { opacity: .55; }
  #gtow-meter .gm b { color: #d6e2ee; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } #gtow-meter .gm.walled b { color: #ff9a9a; }
  #gtow-meter .gm .d { color: #6f8195; }
  #gtow-meter .gm .trk { width: 56px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2c3a4a; overflow: hidden; }
  #gtow-meter .gm .fill { display: block; height: 100%; background: #5ee39a; } #gtow-meter .gm .fill.warn { background: #ffcf70; } #gtow-meter .gm .fill.crit { background: #ff8a80; }
  #gtow-meter .gm.all { border-color: #3a4453; }
  section[data-mode] { display: none; } section[data-mode].on { display: block; }
  /* the checklist */
  .checks .chk { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: start; padding: 5px 0; border-top: 1px solid #1c242c; font-size: 14px; }
  .checks .chk:first-child { border-top: 0; }
  .checks .chk .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: 6px; background: #4a5561; }
  .checks .chk.ok .dot { background: #5ee39a; } .checks .chk.bad .dot { background: #ff8a80; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,138,128,.18); } .checks .chk.busy .dot { background: #ffce56; }
  .checks .chk b { display: block; } .checks .chk .d { color: #8fa1b3; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .checks .chk .req { font-size: 11px; color: #8fa1b3; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; padding-top: 4px; }
  .checks .chk.bad .req { color: #ff8a80; }
  /* GTO Wizard accounts: the pool behind the one GTO Wizard row, opened with its button */
  .checks .gacc-btn { margin-top: 4px; background: none; border: 1px solid #2a3540; color: #8fa1b3; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
  .checks .gacc-btn:hover { color: #d7e1ea; border-color: #3a4855; }
  .checks .gacc { margin: 6px 0 2px; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
  .checks .gacc .ga { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: start; padding: 5px 8px; background: #121a21; border: 1px solid #1c242c; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 5px; }
  .checks .gacc .ga.up .dot { background: #5ee39a; } .checks .gacc .ga.warn .dot { background: #ffce56; } .checks .gacc .ga.down .dot { background: #ff8a80; }
  .checks .gacc .ga.off { opacity: .55; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .nm { font-weight: 700; } .checks .gacc .ga .cap { font-size: 11px; color: #8fa1b3; margin-left: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .cap.mw { color: #9fc6ff; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .d { display: block; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .who { display: block; color: #d7e1ea; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .who .pid { color: #8fa1b3; font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; margin-left: 6px; }
  .checks .gacc .ga .dup { display: block; color: #ffce56; font-size: 12px; }
  .checks .gacc .ga button { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #2a3540; background: #17212a; color: #d7e1ea; cursor: pointer; }
  .checks .gacc .ga button:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
  details.conn summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #8fa1b3; font-weight: 700; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
  details.conn summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
  details.conn summary .st { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: 600; }
  details.conn summary .st.ok { color: #5ee39a; } details.conn summary .st.bad { color: #ff8a80; } details.conn summary .st.busy { color: #ffce56; }
  details.conn summary .tw { margin-left: auto; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
  /* The rolled pick: the single actionable answer, unmissable — and a BUTTON:
     one press (or Enter / Space) relays it to the table through the same
     relay the action buttons use. Disabled with the reason when it cannot. */
  #sa-pick { display: block; width: 100%; font-family: inherit; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 900; border: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 6px 0; text-align: center; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
  #sa-pick:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }
  #sa-pick.ready { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
  #sa-pick:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }
  #sa-pick .roll { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; opacity: .85; letter-spacing: .05em; }
  #sa-pick .go { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; opacity: .9; letter-spacing: .04em; margin-top: 4px; }
  #sa-ready { font-size: 13px; margin: 2px 0 6px; }
  #sa-ready.ok { color: #5ee39a; } #sa-ready.no { color: #8fa1b3; } #sa-ready.bad { color: #ff8a80; }
  #sa-auto-row { display: none; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 6px 0; font-size: 13px; color: #ffce56; }
  #sa-auto-row input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: #ffce56; }
  #sa-pick.fold { background: #8c2f39; }
  #sa-pick.check, #sa-pick.call { background: #1f7a4d; }
  #sa-pick.raise, #sa-pick.bet { background: #b96a1f; }
  #sa-pick.allin { background: #6d3fa8; }
  /* ON DEMAND (2026-09-30): the Solve button stands where the pick will appear */
  #sa-solve { display: block; width: 100%; font-family: inherit; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 900; border: 3px solid #7fb2ff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 6px 0; text-align: center; color: #fff; background: #1d4f91; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  #sa-solve:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }
  #sa-solve:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: default; }
  #sa-solve .sub2 { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; opacity: .85; letter-spacing: .03em; margin-top: 2px; }
  .card { background: #171d24; border: 1px solid #26303a; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .card h2 { font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #8fa1b3; margin: 0 0 8px; }
  /* fold: every game card folds to its title bar, so the game state and the
     study answer can sit in one viewport without scrolling. */
  .card > h2 { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
  .card > h2 .badge { margin: 0; }
  .card > h2 .cardfold { margin-left: auto; background: transparent; color: #6b7d8f; border: 0; border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; padding: 3px 7px; cursor: pointer; }
  .card > h2 .cardfold:hover { color: #cfe0ef; background: #22303d; }
  .card.collapsed { padding: 8px 12px; }
  .card.collapsed > h2 { margin: 0; }
  .card.collapsed > *:not(h2) { display: none !important; }
  #mirror { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; display: none; }
  button { background: #1f6feb; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
  button:disabled { background: #26303a; color: #5b6b7a; cursor: default; }
  #verdict { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 6px; }
  #verdict.ok { color: #5ee39a; } #verdict.warn { color: #ffce56; }
  pre { background: #0c1013; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; font-size: 11.5px; max-height: 260px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; }
  .big { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffce56; }
  .toggle { opacity: .45; }
  #ctl-status { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; margin: 2px 0 10px; color: #8fa1b3; }
  #ctl-status.turn { color: #ffce56; }
  #btns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .act { width: 100%; padding: 18px 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid transparent; color: #fff; }
  .act:disabled { opacity: .35; }
  .act.fold { background: #8c2f39; }
  .act.check, .act.call { background: #1f7a4d; }
  .act.raise, .act.bet { background: #b96a1f; }
  .act.allin { background: #6d3fa8; }
  .cs-board { display: flex; gap: 7px; margin: 8px 0; min-height: 52px; }
  .cs-board .cardb { width: 38px; height: 52px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1.5px solid #46586a; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; background: #f4f6f8; color: #111; }
  .cs-board .cardb.back { background: #b3541e; border-color: #8c3f12; }
  .cs-board .cardb.red { color: #c42126; }
  .cs-facts { font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .cs-facts .you { color: #5ee39a; font-weight: 800; }
  .cs-facts .onseat { color: #ffce56; font-weight: 700; }
  #cs-pills { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #cs-pills .pill { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 20px; padding: 3px 12px; background: #22303d; color: #cfe0ef; border: 1px solid #3a4a5a; }
  #cs-pills .pill.pos { background: #1f3b57; color: #8fd0ff; border-color: #2f5c86; }
  #cs-pills .pill.out { background: #3a2c1e; color: #ffce56; border-color: #5c4626; }
  #cs-pills .pill.fold { background: #3a1a1a; color: #ff8a80; border-color: #5c2626; }
  .cs-facts .folded { color: #ff8a80; font-weight: 700; }
  #cs-history { margin-top: 10px; }
  #cs-history .hl { font-size: 16px; padding: 2px 0 2px 10px; border-left: 2px solid #26303a; }
  #cs-history .hs-title { font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: #ffce56; font-weight: 700; margin: 8px 0 3px; }
  #cs-history details { margin: 4px 0; }
  #cs-history summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: #8fa1b3; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 0; }
  #cs-history summary:hover { color: #cfe0ef; }
  /* Game state: dense, glanceable, and readable across the room — the cards and
     the seat are what you check against the felt, so they are the biggest thing
     on the card. */
  .gs-head { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.4; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap;
             gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; }
  .gs-head .gs-cards { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; }
  .gs-head .gs-seat { color: #8fd0ff; }
  .gs-head .gs-street { color: #ffce56; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 15px;
                        letter-spacing: .08em; }
  .gs-row { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 4px; }
  .gs-row .gs-k { color: #5b6b7a; margin-right: 5px; }
  .gs-turn-yes { color: #5ee39a; font-weight: 700; }
  .gs-turn-no { color: #8fa1b6; }
  .gs-src { margin-top: 7px; border-top: 1px solid #1e2731; padding-top: 5px;
            color: #5b6b7a; font-size: 12px; }
  .gs-bad { color: #ff6b6b; }
  .gs-warn { color: #ffce56; }
  .gs-hero { color: #5ee39a; }
  .curhand { font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.55; max-height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; }
  .curhand .fl { padding: 2px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e2731; }
  .curhand .fl .ts { color: #5b6b7a; font-size: 12px; margin-right: 8px; }
  .curhand .fl.street { color: #ffce56; font-weight: 700; }
  .curhand .fl.turn { color: #5ee39a; font-weight: 700; }
  .curhand .fl.hand { color: #8fd0ff; }
  #raiserow { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #raiserow input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; padding: 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid #3a4a5a; background: #0c1013; color: #ffce56; text-align: center; }
  #raiserow button { padding: 10px; font-size: 20px; }
  .mini { padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #3a4a5a; background: #22303d; color: #cfe0ef; cursor: pointer; }
  a.mini { text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; }
  .rec { border: 1px solid #26303a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .rec-h { font-size: 13.5px; color: #cfe0ef; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .rec-h .ids { color: #8fd0ff; }
  .rec textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 44px; font-size: 14px; background: #0c1013; color: #e8edf2; border: 1px solid #3a4a5a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px; resize: vertical; }
  .rec .mini { margin-top: 4px; }
  .rec-view { margin-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #26303a; padding-top: 8px; }
  .rec-view img { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; display: block; background: #0c1013; }
  .rec-ctl { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 6px 0; }
  .rec-ctl input[type=range] { flex: 1; }
  .rec-ctl .pos { font-size: 12.5px; color: #8fa1b3; min-width: 92px; text-align: right; }
  .rec-state { font-size: 12.5px; background: #0c1013; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px; max-height: 190px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.45; }
  .rec-state b { color: #ffce56; }
  #presets { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .preset { flex: 1; padding: 12px 6px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #3a4a5a; background: #22303d; color: #cfe0ef; }
  .preset:disabled { opacity: .35; }
  /* Feed audit: actual table vs the study table answers are drawn from */
  .fs-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  .fs-title { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #8fa1b3; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 5px; }
  .fs-title.shown { color: #8fd0ff; }
  .fs-kv { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
  .fs-kv b { color: #e8edf2; font-weight: 700; }
  .fs-kv .k { color: #8fa1b3; }
  .fs-line { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13.5px; color: #ffce56; }
  .disc { font-size: 14.5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; margin: 3px 0; border-left: 3px solid; }
  .disc .dv { font-weight: 800; }
  .disc .dn { color: #8fa1b3; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .disc.info  { border-color: #46586a; background: #1a222b; color: #cfe0ef; }
  .disc.minor { border-color: #b98a1f; background: #2a2416; color: #ffce56; }
  .disc.major { border-color: #b9401f; background: #2a1816; color: #ff8a80; }
  .disc.none  { border-color: #2f7c56; background: #14261c; color: #5ee39a; }
  .links { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .mono { font-family: Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; }

<script>
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/</g, "<").replace(/"/g, """);
  const badge = (id, ok, txt) => { const b = $(id); b.className = "badge " + (ok ? "ok" : "bad"); b.textContent = txt; };
  const GTOW_API = "http://127.0.0.1:2000";
  // CLOSING A COINPOKER PANEL CLOSES ITS TABLE (2026-10-01): with a session running, the window's X asks first. Browsers
  // allow only their own generic "Leave site?" prompt here (and only once the page has been clicked); what closes is
  // this panel and its table in the client, after the hand in play — see the wrapper's session.cpCloseOut.
  let LAST_STATE = null, UNLOAD_OK = false;
  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", (e) => {
    if (UNLOAD_OK || !LAST_STATE || LAST_STATE.site !== "coinpoker" || !LAST_STATE.sessionId) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.returnValue = "Closing this panel ends its session and closes its CoinPoker table after this hand.";
  });

  // ================= modes =================
  // Game: what you need at the table. Analysis: the instruments. Pollers
  // only run for the mode that is showing, so the game page never pays for
  // the mirror, the protocol dump or the feed audit.
  let MODE = "game";
  let modeExplicit = false;
  let analysisEntered = false;
  // THE WINDOW TITLE IS HOW THE WRAPPER FINDS THIS WINDOW (2026-10-01): the server stamps this panel's tag on it
  // ("Poker Wrapper #2"). Switching modes used to set a bare "Poker Wrapper", dropping the tag — the #2 wrapper then
  // could not find its window, read it as closed and ended its session 8 s later, window still open.
  const BASE_TITLE = document.title.replace(/ · Analysis$/, "");
  function setMode(m, push = true) {
    MODE = m === "analysis" ? "analysis" : "game";
    document.querySelectorAll("section[data-mode]").forEach(s => s.classList.toggle("on", s.dataset.mode === MODE));
    document.querySelectorAll(".modes button").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.mode === MODE));
    document.title = MODE === "analysis" ? `${BASE_TITLE} · Analysis` : BASE_TITLE;
    if (push) { const u = new URL(location.href); u.searchParams.set("mode", MODE); history.replaceState({}, "", u); }
    if (MODE === "analysis" && !analysisEntered) { analysisEntered = true; loadRecs(); }
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".modes button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { modeExplicit = true; setMode(b.dataset.mode); });
  { const q = new URL(location.href).searchParams.get("mode"); if (q) { modeExplicit = true; setMode(q, false); } }
  const active = m => MODE === m;

  // ================= folding cards =================
  // Mid-hand the panel is read at a glance, and the two things that have to be
  // read TOGETHER are the game state (is this my table, my seat, my cards?) and
  // the answer computed from it. So every game card folds to its title bar, and
  // only those two open by default — the rest are one click away, and whatever
  // you leave open is remembered for next time.
  const CARDS_OPEN_BY_DEFAULT = new Set(["gs-card", "sa-card", "rg-card"]);
  (function foldableCards() {
    let saved = {};
    try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("panel.cards") || "{}") || {}; } catch (e) { saved = {}; }
    const remember = () => { try { localStorage.setItem("panel.cards", JSON.stringify(saved)); } catch (e) {} };
    document.querySelectorAll('section[data-mode="game"] > .card').forEach((card, i) => {
      const h2 = card.querySelector(":scope > h2");
      if (!h2) return;
      const key = card.id || ("card" + i);
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "cardfold";
      btn.type = "button";
      // never in the tab order, and blurred the moment it is clicked: a focused
      // button would eat the Enter/Space that executes the study pick.
      btn.tabIndex = -1;
      const paint = () => {
        const open = !card.classList.contains("collapsed");
        btn.textContent = open ? "–" : "+";
        btn.title = open ? "minimize this card" : "maximize this card";
        btn.setAttribute("aria-label", (open ? "minimize " : "maximize ") + (h2.textContent || key).trim());
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
      };
      const wantOpen = typeof saved[key] === "boolean" ? saved[key] : CARDS_OPEN_BY_DEFAULT.has(key);
      card.classList.toggle("collapsed", !wantOpen);
      h2.appendChild(btn);
      paint();
      const toggle = (e) => {
        if (e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }
        card.classList.toggle("collapsed");
        paint();
        saved[key] = !card.classList.contains("collapsed");
        remember();
        btn.blur();
      };
      btn.addEventListener("click", toggle);
      h2.addEventListener("click", (e) => { if (e.target !== btn) toggle(e); });
    });
  })();

  // ================= connection: one list, both modes =================
  // The session's own checklist re-run by the wrapper (GET /session/checks):
  // the table link, the API, the chart server, the two overlays, the GTO
  // Wizard token, the recorder. The wrapper reconnects GTO Wizard on its own;
  // the row says so while it does. The header pill mirrors the verdict.
  let connWasBad = false;
  let checksTimer = null, lastChecks = null;
  async function loadChecks() {
    clearTimeout(checksTimer);
    let j;
    try { j = await (await fetch("/session/checks")).json(); }
    catch (e) { $("sa-checks").innerHTML = '<div class="sub">wrapper not answering</div>'; setPill("bad", "wrapper not answering"); clearTimeout(checksTimer); checksTimer = setTimeout(loadChecks, 5000); return; }
    lastChecks = j;
    renderChecks(j);
    const busy = j.chain && j.chain.attempting;
    const down = (j.blockers || []).length;
    const st = j.ok ? "ok" : busy ? "busy" : "bad";
    const txt = j.ok ? "all up" : busy ? `reconnecting… (${down} down)` : `${down} required down: ${(j.blockers || []).join(", ")}`;
    $("conn-st").className = "st " + st; $("conn-st").textContent = txt;
    $("conn-when").textContent = new Date(j.checkedAt || Date.now()).toLocaleTimeString();
    setPill(st, j.ok ? "connected" : busy ? "reconnecting…" : `${down} down — ${(j.blockers || [])[0] || ""}`);
    // something required went down: open the list so the reason is in view
    if (!j.ok && !connWasBad) $("conn-details").open = true;
    connWasBad = !j.ok;
    // Capture QA is the instrumentation mode: open on Analysis unless the URL said otherwise
    if (!modeExplicit && j.preset === "capture-qa" && MODE !== "analysis") setMode("analysis", false);
    clearTimeout(checksTimer);
    checksTimer = setTimeout(loadChecks, 10000);
  }
  function renderChecks(j) {
    const busy = j.chain && j.chain.attempting;
    const rows = (j.checks || []).map((c) => {
      const isG = c.id === "gtow";
      const cls = c.ok ? "ok" : !c.required ? "off" : (isG && busy ? "busy" : "bad");
      const extra = isG && !c.ok ? (busy ? ' · <span class="spin">⟳</span> reconnecting on its own…' : j.chain?.lastResult && !j.chain.lastResult.connected ? ` · last attempt: ${esc(j.chain.lastResult.text || "failed")} — retries every 2 min` : "") : "";
      return `<div class="chk ${cls}"><span class="dot"></span><span><b>${esc(c.label)}</b><span class="d">${esc(c.detail)}${extra}</span>${isG ? gtowAccounts(c.sessions) : ""}</span><span class="req">${c.required ? "required" : "optional"}</span></div>`;
    });
    $("sa-checks").innerHTML = rows.join("") || '<div class="sub">no checks</div>';
  }
  // GTO Wizard is a POOL of accounts behind the one row above: its button lists every one the API knows (disabled
  // ones greyed), each with its state, plan capability, token time and its own Connect. Open state and an in-flight
  // Connect survive the 10 s re-render.
  let gaccOpen = false;
  const gaccMsg = {};
  function gtowAccounts(ss) {
    ss = ss || [];
    if (!ss.length) return "";
    const live = ss.filter((x) => x.state === "up").length, on = ss.filter((x) => x.enabled !== false).length;
    const btn = `<div><button class="gacc-btn" data-gacc-toggle>${gaccOpen ? "▾" : "▸"} ${ss.length} account${ss.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} · ${live} of ${on} live</button></div>`;
    if (!gaccOpen) return btn;
    // the same login in two windows is worth a warning; two DIFFERENT logins on the same plan is fine and the
    // account line is what tells them apart
    const byAcct = {};
    for (const x of ss) { const k = x.accountId || x.account; if (k) (byAcct[k] = byAcct[k] || []).push(x.id); }
    // the registry's light when the wrapper could read /api/gtow/accounts (walled = red), else the pool's state
    const cls = (x) => x.enabled === false ? "off" : x.light ? (x.light === "up" ? "up" : x.light === "no-token" || x.light === "signed-out" ? "warn" : "down")
      : x.state === "up" ? "up" : ["blocked", "no-token", "unknown"].includes(x.state) ? "warn" : "down";
    const rows = ss.map((x) => {
      const meter = x.h1 == null ? "" : x.light === "walled" ? "WALLED" : `${Number(x.h1).toLocaleString()}/${Number(x.cap || 2250).toLocaleString()} this hour`;
      const bits = [meter, x.enabled === false ? "disabled" : (x.lightText || x.blockedReason || x.text || x.state || ""),
